name: Cursor Agent CLI
important: The invoked command is `agent`, not `cursor-agent`. The npm/binary is installed as cursor-agent but the CLI you run is `agent`. `-f`/`--force` (auto-approve) is REQUIRED for it to modify files in a headless run; without it the agent plans but changes nothing — a silent no-op that looks like failure.

transcript.note: --output-format json returns a structured final result; also `agent ls` lists prior chats.

busy.note: print mode synchronous; Aug 2026 build retries wedged uploads on long headless sessions instead of hanging.
